Split flowlines (sequential, flowpath_id-based)

Source: R/split_flowlines.R
split_flowlines.Rd

Split flowlines by events and/or a max segment length. Returns semantic IDs with .part suffix ordered upstream (.1) -> downstream (.N).

Usage

split_flowlines(
  flines,
  max_length = NULL,
  events = NULL,
  avoid = NA,
  min_split_m = 10
)

Arguments

flines

sf LINESTRINGs with columns:

  • flowpath_id (coerced to character)

  • one downstream column: flowpath_toid | toCOMID | toid (kept as-is)

  • LENGTHKM (will be recomputed from geometry) CRS should be projected in meters for length-based splitting.

max_length

numeric (meters). If NULL, only event splits apply.

events

data.frame of event matches with per-event measures: required: flowpath_id, REACHCODE, FromMeas, ToMeas, REACH_meas optional: identifier (passed through to output)

avoid

vector of flowpath_id to exclude from length splitting (events still apply).

min_split_m

numeric (meters). Minimum piece length: an event split that would create a fragment shorter than this is dropped. Default 10.

Value

sf with split flowlines; includes event_* fields and recomputed LENGTHKM.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
flines <- sf::st_read("refactored.gpkg", "refactored")
segs <- split_flowlines(flines, max_length = 2000)
} # }
